components.backend_contract: Uses the process-level Container singleton and adapts flat FinancialAgent analysis results; Alpaca account snapshots use TradingClient(paper=True).

subsystem_contracts.name: main_application
subsystem_contracts.execution_paths: main.py starts an interactive CLI with its own gateway thread; the launcher-managed gateway uses service_entrypoint.py. These are separate paths and must not be started concurrently against the same ports.
subsystem_contracts.application_wiring: ultron/infrastructure/container.py provides the application Container singleton used by the financial dashboard and gateway wiring.
persistence: SQLite-backed task and operation lifecycle records
separate memory, knowledge, and experience stores

subsystem_contracts.name: launcher_and_supervision
subsystem_contracts.identity_and_readiness: The manager validates executable realpath, working directory, command identity, recorded process start ticks, and managed process group before treating a record as owned. Per-service readiness probes are required; an open listener alone is insufficient.
subsystem_contracts.state: Owner-only services.json under $XDG_STATE_HOME/ultron/interface-launcher or ~/.local/state/ultron/interface-launcher; manager lease and control socket are separate runtime artifacts.

subsystem_contracts.name: authentication_and_frontend_state
subsystem_contracts.contract: The browser contacts the loopback helper; after private local unlock the helper opens the authenticated gateway WebSocket. The backend derives principal identity from the authenticated connection. The frontend keeps cached results visibly stale while disconnected.
subsystem_contracts.security: The helper preserves exact origin allowlists and local credential handling; gateway authorization remains server-side.

subsystem_contracts.name: system_intelligence
subsystem_contracts.data_flow: Authenticated gateway request to a read-only host/process/listener snapshot, then a frontend System Intelligence view.
subsystem_contracts.persistence: Owner-only diagnostic observations in system-intelligence.db below launcher state; live operations database was not read.
subsystem_contracts.freshness: Each observation carries source, observation time, and status; missing tools/probes stay UNKNOWN or UNAVAILABLE.

subsystem_contracts.name: cre_and_persisted_evidence
subsystem_contracts.gateway_contract: Authenticated CRE_STATUS_REQUEST maps the gateway principal to the owner-filtered ContentRightsService projection. Scene-gallery delivery uses authenticated CRE status and persisted scene evidence.
subsystem_contracts.persistence: data/ultron_cre.db; not opened during this audit. ContentStore schema is 7, publishing-attempt schema is 9, and scene contract schema is 2 in current source.
subsystem_contracts.restrictions: Publishing is reported as mock-only; unconfigured rendering/processing is not represented as available.

subsystem_contracts.name: financial_trading_and_voice
subsystem_contracts.financial_controls: Financial construction requires simulation mode; paper-trade authorization remains fail-closed. The standalone dashboard's Alpaca account reads use paper mode and its Streamlit surface is separate from local-unlock authentication.
subsystem_contracts.voice_controls: The managed service explicitly selects Edge. XTTS and DSP codec dependencies are lazy/optional; reference_staging is not part of the production runtime path.

subsystem_contracts.name: release_backup_and_recovery
subsystem_contracts.release_contract: Explicit file list; deterministic archive timestamps; per-file SHA-256 manifest; archive verification; restore to a separate destination.
subsystem_contracts.database_contract: SQLite online backup API; integrity, schema/user_version, size and digest checks; live CRE and operations databases were not accessed.

confirmed_repairs.issue: Standalone financial dashboard constructed another application Container despite an existing module-level singleton.
confirmed_repairs.repair: Dashboard reuses the process-level singleton to avoid duplicate repositories and runtime stores.

confirmed_repairs.issue: Dashboard adapter expected a legacy nested FinancialAgent result and omitted the current flat result fields.
confirmed_repairs.repair: Adapter accepts the current flat response as well as the legacy nested shape and exercises the actual rendering path.

confirmed_repairs.issue: Dashboard status conflated local analysis receipt with provider freshness and did not show a successful account-snapshot time.
confirmed_repairs.repair: Displays local receipt time separately and records account refresh time only after account, positions, and orders all succeed.

confirmed_repairs.issue: Streamlit was directly used but missing from the root Python dependency manifest; dashboard startup did not establish simulation mode by default.
confirmed_repairs.repair: Declared Streamlit, defaulted the dashboard launcher to simulation without overriding explicit values, and retained the application's fail-closed mode validation.
